children: According to Wallstreetcn, at a regular press briefing held by China's Ministry of Commerce on the 10th, ministry spokesperson Huang Ling said the U.S. and Chinese trade teams are seriously implementing the consensus reached at the leaders' Beijing meeting and are negotiating a $30 billion reciprocal tariff cut framework arrangement, seeking early implementation.

title: U.S.-China Trade Teams Discuss $30 Billion Reciprocal Tariff Cut Framework
